title: Timely
summary: Pull your calendar availability in 3 seconds
content: Timely: Pull your calendar availability in 3 seconds | Product Hunt Launching today Timely Launching today Pull your calendar availability in 3 seconds 207 followers Pull your calendar availability in 3 seconds 207 followers Visit website Scheduling software Pull your availability from connected calendars, with a single keystroke, within whichever timezone suits your recipient best. No opening the calendar, no timezone maths, and it handles multiple execs too. It's completely private and sits locally on your machine, connecting only to Outlook and Google. Overview Reviews Alternatives Built with Team Awards More Free Options Launch tags: Email • Productivity • Calendar 3 months free Launch Team / Built With Show more Show more Launching Today # 5 Day Rank Upvote • 177 points Follow Timely Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info trytimely.co Timely Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/timely-9 Similar Products Cron Next-generation calendar for professionals and teams 4.8 ( 96 reviews ) Calendar apps Team collaboration software Morgen Where time for your work+life+hustle are managed, your way. 4.8 ( 33 reviews ) Productivity Calendar apps Vimcal Fly through your calendar 4.6 ( 14 reviews ) Calendar apps Toki: AI Scheduling & Tasks Meet your AI scheduling agent that turns ideas into plans 5.0 ( 18 reviews ) Scheduling software Akiflow Being always well organised is possible. 4.6 ( 18 reviews ) Calendar apps Time tracking apps View more Subscribe Sign in Framer AI Agents Design and publish professional sites with AI Try Framer AI Agents Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment James Ketteringham Timely Maker 📌 I spent much of my days in meetings, many of which I have to schedule myself - across timezones. I was tired of pulling up outlook, looking at open slots, trying to convert to my recipients timezone, and then manually typing out which times I was available. Calendly wasn't a fit for me either, since my clients do not want to feel as though they're having to do the leg work. So I built this tool for myself really - until realising how useful it might be for others who book their own meetings, but also executive and personal assistants, who book on behalf of their principals. So here it is... dead simple, solves a very boring problem, and most importantly reduces the 'find my availability' task down to seconds. content: Scribble Party: A local-first whiteboard studio for teachers and creators | Product Hunt Launching today Scribble Party Launching today A local-first whiteboard studio for teachers and creators 172 followers A local-first whiteboard studio for teachers and creators 172 followers Visit website Digital whiteboards Most lesson recorders send your video to someone's cloud and want an account first. Scribble Party runs entirely in your browser. Draw on an infinite canvas, drop a live camera bubble of yourself on the board (it cuts out your background), and record the whole thing with your voice. content: Pocket Screen: Keep any Mac window visible in a floating mini screen | Product Hunt Launching today Pocket Screen Launching today Keep any Mac window visible in a floating mini screen 254 followers Keep any Mac window visible in a floating mini screen 254 followers Visit website App switcher Pocket Screen turns the frontmost window on your Mac into a compact, always-on-top PiP-style view. Keep documents, chats, videos, or reference material visible while you work in another app—without constantly switching windows. Processing stays on your Mac. Overview Reviews Alternatives Built with Team Awards More Free Options Launch tags: Mac • Productivity • Menu Bar Apps 30% off lifetime access Launch Team / Built With Show more Show more Launching Today # 4 Day Rank Upvote • 217 points Follow Pocket Screen Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info labs.toybird.com/apps/pocket-screen Pocket Screen Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/toybird-labs Similar Products Lasso - Window Manager for macOS Easily organize windows with just a few clicks 4.9 ( 44 reviews ) Rectangle Move & resize windows in MacOS via shortcuts & snap areas 5.0 ( 6 reviews ) Hand Mirror A one-click camera check, right from the menu bar 5.0 ( 5 reviews ) Camera apps Screenshots and screen recording apps ScreenHint Always-visible Snapshots 5.0 ( 1 review ) Productivity Design & Creative HazeOver Focus and reduce visual noise 5.0 ( 3 reviews ) Productivity View more Subscribe Sign in Framer AI Agents Design and publish professional sites with AI Try Framer AI Agents Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Masaki Iino Pocket Screen Maker 📌 Hi Product Hunt! 👋 I’m Masaki, an indie developer behind Toybird Labs. I built Pocket Screen because I often work on a single Mac display and kept losing focus while switching between a document, browser, chat, and the app I was actually working in. Pocket Screen turns the current frontmost window into a compact, always-on-top PiP-style window. You can keep a document beside your writing, watch a tutorial while following along, monitor chat, or reference a dashboard without constantly changing windows. It is controlled from the menu bar or a global shortcut, and the floating window can be moved, resized, adjusted for opacity, or made click-through. Captured content is displayed locally and is not uploaded. The app is free to try with 10-minute sessions, with a one-time in-app purchase for unlimited use. I’d love to hear how you use it and what would make it more useful in your daily workflow. Thanks for checking it out!
